baseline.description: Predict log1p Cu from 50 nearest retained training sites in EPSG:3005 with inverse-squared-distance weights. Break distance ties by sample ID. candidates.configuration: Fit a mean log1p Cu per source rock_class with shrinkage of 20 pseudo-observations at the overall training mean: (sum_class + 20*globalMean)/(n_class+20). Clip predicted log1p Cu below zero to zero. No hyperparameter search.

evaluation.execution: Before fitting, registry-bind actual source/normalized/geology/prior-inventory bytes, exact memberships, evaluator and commitment. Fit on train only. All metadata reference sets are outcome-independent. No membership reallocation after exclusions.

covariate.definition: Intersect the derived component support with GA32366 named geological regions in EPSG:3577. Dissolve polygons sharing the exact trimmed region label; no assay-based relabeling. Use the complete support area as denominator. If documented non-null region coverage is at least 95% and exactly one named region covers strictly more than 50% of support, use that name. Otherwise use UNKNOWN. If differently named regions overlap within the support by more than 1 square metre, use UNKNOWN and report the ambiguity. Do not drop such sites or choose labels by target values.
covariate.prohibited: NGSA-derived PCA, copper/geochemical anomaly classes, mineral occurrences, other measured elements, field pH/colour/lithology, economic features and inferred depth are prohibited covariates. Geological classification is broad source context, not independently observed subsurface truth.

split.group: Project the selected source site coordinate from documented GDA94 to EPSG:3577. gridX=floor(easting/250000), gridY=floor(northing/250000), group=gridX:gridY. Use mathematical floor for negative coordinates. The component has one representative and cannot cross partitions.
split.assignment: SHA256 UTF8 ngsa-tos-coarse-cu-total-georegions-v1|<gridX>:<gridY>; unsigned first 8 hexadecimal digits modulo 100: 0..59 train, 60..79 validation, 80..99 audit. No alternate seed or regrouping.
split.distance: Spherical haversine for nearest neighbours/coincidence/prior locations, radius 6371.0088 km; clamp haversine term to [0,1]. Preserve source datum/precision limitations.
split.buffer: Using all initially eligible metadata support components, remove train when its minimum polygon distance in EPSG:3577 is strictly less than 50000 metres from any validation or audit support; remove validation when its support is similarly close to any audit support. Fixed reference sets; no restoration/reassignment after exclusions. Audit support unchanged. These are projected-distance buffers, not exact geodesic distances.
split.minimums: After target filtering, every partition must retain at least 100 representatives in at least 8 spatial grid groups. Otherwise stop without fitting, relaxing buffers, changing group size or choosing another audit. These transferred minimums are feasibility guards, not a power calculation.

baseline.configuration: The 50 nearest retained training representatives by the declared spherical distance; ties by canonical sample ID in Unicode code-point order. Inverse-squared-distance weighted log1p Cu. Exact zero distance uses the mean of all zero-distance training targets. No tuning.

candidate.configuration: Global mean of retained training log1p Cu. For a known region, mean=(class target sum+20*globalMean)/(class count+20). UNKNOWN/unseen region uses globalMean. Training residuals subtract those means. Predict query region mean plus baseline-identical 50-neighbour inverse-squared-distance weighted residuals; clip negative final log prediction to 0. One fixed candidate; training targets only.

evaluation.metric: Representative-weighted RMSE in natural log1p Cu; relative improvement=1-candidateRMSE/baselineRMSE. Also report MAE, sample/group counts, unknown-region coverage and exclusions. Baseline RMSE of zero makes relative improvement undefined and cannot pass.
evaluation.uncertainty: 2000 paired audit spatial-group bootstrap replicates with NumPy 2.3.5 Generator(PCG64(20261021)). Sort group IDs in Unicode code-point order; draw the original number of groups uniformly with replacement; include every member with multiplicity. Compute pooled representative-weighted RMSE relative improvement and linear 2.5/97.5 percentiles. Undefined replicates mean inconclusive; never redraw. This is grouped resampling uncertainty, not calibrated location intervals.
evaluation.execution: Before fitting, archive and registry-bind actual source/prior/geology/normalization/evaluator bytes, exact memberships and this commitment. Fit only on train. Bind the training model, validation predictions and audit predictions before scoring audit labels. Evaluate exactly one fixed audit even if the validation gate fails; any attempt after audit start consumes it. Candidate choices never depend on validation or audit outcomes.
evaluation.gate: Qualify only when validation improvement>=0.02, audit improvement>=0.02, the audit bootstrap lower bound>0, and every source/lineage/membership check passes. Otherwise retain the spatial baseline, or record inconclusive for undefined statistics. Passing does not authorize unsampled-region, deposit, depth or economic predictions.
evaluation.budget: Exactly one baseline, one candidate and one audit; no search or retuning. One exact Cu CSV <=64 MiB, one GA73085 shapefile archive <=64 MiB and one GA32366 archive <=64 MiB; extracted data <=512 MiB total. Read package documentation first; no alternate distributions/source substitutions after a failure. Sequential requests with >=1 second spacing, source Retry-After honored, TLS verified and <=60 seconds per request; stop on denied access, challenge or budget limits, no automatic retry/bypass. Local CPU only, maximum two numerical threads, no paid services or unattended AI calls.

requiredBeforeFreeze: Verify exact package/CSV notices, schema and field-method/censor semantics; no values may be presented as admitted merely because bytes were downloaded.
Establish the final catchment crosswalk, complete source geometries and current named-region lineage. Resolve NGSA-derived attributes or stop; no unproven 2007 hindcast.
Reproduce the pinned field identity inventory and all prior-source identity/coordinate inventories; implement and test this source-specific normalization and geometry/membership auditor.
Archive exact source, normalized, feature, prior, runtime, evaluator and membership bytes; enforce all fixed minimums before fitting.
Commit training-only model and complete fixed predictions before the single consumed audit; retain negative/inconclusive results without replacement.
limitations: Published related BOS copper aggregates were already exposed. This is a retrospective design after metadata inspection, not pristine blinding or a prospective validation.

Transported sediment, sparse nonuniform coverage, sampling-access changes and radiation-screen exclusions limit representativeness. Quantified-only regression and fixed representative selection can exclude usable samples; this bias stays explicit.

The 1:5 million named geological regions are coarse. Dominant-area classification discards mixtures, and unrecorded interpretative/geochemical inputs may remain. Separate provenance does not establish geological truth.

Final polygons were adjusted after fieldwork; support grouping is an approximation. Projected distances, coordinate uncertainty, long-range dependence and catchment connectivity beyond the mapped units remain limitations.
The fixed per-partition minima may be infeasible after 250 km grouping and 50 km support buffering. Failure is a valid result; it is not permission to change the study.

Different support, target, covariate and baseline prevent interpreting this score alongside the soil/BC results as a learning trend. This experiment cannot demonstrate improved research-selection policy or verified copper supply.
document.deviationPolicy: Archive this document unchanged. Record mechanical header/parser adaptations with hashes and exposure chronology before scoring; do not change target/covariate semantics, grouping, seed, buffers, representative selection, model, budget or gate. Unexpected source semantics, unresolved lineage/permission, missing crosswalk or insufficient cohorts stop this study. Any substantively different future design must disclose exposure and obtain genuinely unexposed independent evaluation evidence; changing an ID does not reset an audit.
document.scope: Method preparation and released identity metadata only. No NGSA Cu CSV or geological feature package acquired at commitment, no fitted model or audit result, and no verified improvement or supply forecast.

document.scope: Retrospective geographic validation conditional on a publisher-dated 1:500,000 map. No historical hindcast, external blinding, total-copper, ore-discovery, depth, reserves or deliverable-supply claim.
document.target: Cu_mgkg_ICPar, sheet6175xxA-6307xxA columnK, mg/kg. Natural log1p(max(reported numeric value,0.01)). Below-LLD source values are half-LLD substituted; evaluate only this floor-capped reporting signal. Never infer row censor flags from equality to0.005. Any missing, text, nonfinite or negative value stops the entire experiment without dropping rows or resplitting. Nominal survey0.05-0.20m is not measured per-row depth; five-auger composite, <2mm milled fraction, partial aqua-regia ICP-AES/MS.
document.cohort: Retain all2820 rows in inventory, sourceRow/ID/coordinates unchanged. Only metadata-based spatial buffer exclusions may remove evaluation membership. No concentration-dependent exclusion. Unique IDs/count agreement do not resolve QC-parent lineage; ~20-21m field duplicates are bounded by5km cross-partition separation, with same-partition dependence unresolved.

split.bufferRule: Original held-out points remain buffer references even when validation membership is later removed. Exclude train if distance<5000m to original validation/audit, validation if distance<5000m to original audit. Never remove audit. Record originalPartition and exclusion; keep every row.
split.failure: Stop without changing grid, salt, origin, source, target, buffer or thresholds. No repeated allocation search.

document.predictors: Easting/northing in published EPSG2157 and exact UNITNAME for unique interior polygon matches. Null for missing/boundary/overlap. Missing and unseen geology use global training mean. No AGE BRACKET, boundary-distance, pH, other assay, ID or sourceRow predictor. No nearest geometry fallback.
document.baseline: Euclidean inverse-square IDW50 of training transformed targets. Use all coincident training points when distance=0, otherwise50 nearest with sample-ID Unicode ordering for ties. Weights(nearestDistance/distance)^2 normalized. No refit on validation.
document.candidate: One geology residual IDW50. Global training mean m, class mean(sum(z_class)+20*m)/(n_class+20); null/unseen->m. Add query class mean to IDW50 of training residuals using identical baseline neighbors/weights. Clip below log1p(0.01). No class merging, feature selection, parameter search or extra candidates.50neighbors/shrinkage20 retained from previously committed model family; consumed soil/BC audits are not retuned.
document.evaluation: Sample-weighted transformed RMSE primary; MAE secondary. Evaluate fixed candidate on audit once even if validation fails.2,000 paired20km audit-group bootstrap draws, sorted groups, NumPy2.5.3 PCG64(20261024), whole groups with replacement, original sample multiplicities, linear2.5th/97.5th percentiles. Undefined zero-baseline draws counted, never redrawn; any makes interval inconclusive. Both validation/audit relative RMSE gains>=0.02 and95% audit lower bound>0 required for numerical gate. No automatic scientific promotion or learned research-policy claim.
document.provenance: GSI/GSNI500k map publication and temporal end2013-12-18, edition2018; package/DBF2024. Not authenticated pre-2020 bytes.100k map not used because its lineage explicitly incorporates Tellus geochemistry. No proven absence of later G7/G9-related updates claimed for500k. Interpreted bedrock is not measured shallow-soil lithology. Regional land-use-selected sampling is not representative global discovery evidence.20km groups/5km buffer do not prove absence of wider autocorrelation.

readiness.interpretation: Descriptive accounting of the same failed metadata allocation, not a retry or alternate split. No assay, prediction, score or measured model improvement. Do not change fixed design to pass.

limitations: Registry events make protocol and exposure history inspectable; they are not model improvements.

New audit starts require archived source, normalized data, evaluator code, model, validation predictions and sealed audit predictions matching frozen identities and memberships. Generic file and row checks alone do not validate scientific execution.

The BC adapter reproduces source normalization, fixed training-only models and sealed predictions before a single score attempt. It applies only to its reviewed retrospective protocol; other sources require adapters. No automatic promotion or learned research policy is connected.
The hash chain detects changed events relative to its published head. A filesystem owner can rewrite local history; external published checkpoints are needed to detect full-chain replacement.

Audit reservations conservatively apply to the entire raw source release, across targets and normalization versions. Repackaging/renaming records can defeat raw-hash and ID-only overlap checks; a source-specific lineage review remains necessary. No reset or reuse operation is provided.
